name: org.cucutime/mcp
title: Cucutime Kids Songs
description: Kids-song ideas, name pages and CucuTime video search (no AI); AI song trial for adult apps.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. "Bearer <developer key>" for the AI tools create_personalized_song and moderate_kids_text, which are for adult-facing apps only (parents, teachers); free trial key at websiteUrl. The keyless tools (generate_song_idea, get_song_for_name, search_catalog) use no AI and need no header.
